eps.d: Harry Perkins, an ex steel worker from Sheffield, is elected Prime Minister by a landslide victory. The establishment, however, is none too pleased with him and set out to stop him in his tracks.
As a result of his controversial views on subjects such as nuclear disarmament, the Prime Minister finds himself battling against an establishment determined to maintain the status quo.
Financial crises, sex scandals and industrial unrest are at their most prevalent, as the storm clouds continue to plague Harry Perkins.
